evidence.notes: Static SOQL list rows can be wrapped in a local QueryLocator.
Static SOQL list rows accept the access-level overload shape.
Static SOQL list rows accept typed AccessLevel.
Object-held static SOQL list rows can feed a local QueryLocator.
Object-held static SOQL list rows accept typed AccessLevel.
Bind-map query locators accept the broad Map access-level shape.
QueryLocator is the iterable local locator object returned by Database locator APIs.
QueryLocator exposes the source query text.
QueryLocator exposes an iterator over its eager local snapshot.
A direct QueryLocator constructor produces an empty local locator.

source.content: public class BatchQueryLocatorOverloadFixtureBatch implements Database.Batchable<Account> { public Database.QueryLocator start(Database.BatchableContext bc) { List<Account> rows = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE 'Batch-%' ORDER BY Name]; Object objectRows = rows; return Database.getQueryLocator(objectRows, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); } public void execute(Database.BatchableContext bc, List<Account> scope) { for (Account row : scope) { insert new Account(Name = 'Seen-' + row.Name); } } public void finish(Database.BatchableContext bc) { insert new Account(Name = 'Finished-' + bc.getJobId()); } }

@isTest private class BatchQueryLocatorOverloadFixtureTest { @isTest static void listObjectAndBindLocatorsFeedBatchTests() { insert new Account(Name = 'Batch-One'); insert new Account(Name = 'Batch-Two'); List<Account> rows = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE 'Batch-%' ORDER BY Name]; String rowsQuery = 'SELECT Id , Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE \'Batch-%\' ORDER BY Name'; Database.QueryLocator emptyLocator = new Database.QueryLocator(); System.assertEquals('', emptyLocator.getQuery()); System.assert(!emptyLocator.iterator().hasNext()); Database.QueryLocator listLocator = Database.getQueryLocator(rows); System.assertEquals(rowsQuery, listLocator.getQuery()); Object listIterator = listLocator.iterator(); System.assert(listIterator.hasNext()); System.assertNotEquals(null, listIterator.next()); Database.QueryLocator accessLocator = Database.getQueryLocator(rows, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assertEquals(rowsQuery, accessLocator.getQuery()); Object objectRows = rows; Database.QueryLocator objectLocator = Database.getQueryLocator(objectRows); System.assert(objectLocator.iterator().hasNext()); Database.QueryLocator objectAccessLocator = Database.getQueryLocator(objectRows, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assert(objectAccessLocator.iterator().hasNext()); Map<String,Object> binds = new Map<String,Object>(); binds.put('wanted', 'Batch-Two'); Database.QueryLocator bindLocator = Database.getQueryLocatorWithBinds('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name = :wanted', binds, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assertEquals('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name = :wanted', bindLocator.getQuery()); Object bindIterator = bindLocator.iterator(); System.assert(bindIterator.hasNext()); Account bindRow = bindIterator.next(); System.assertEquals('Batch-Two', bindRow.Name); System.assert(!bindIterator.hasNext()); Test.startTest(); String jobId = Database.executeBatch(new BatchQueryLocatorOverloadFixtureBatch(), 1); Test.stopTest(); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Seen-Batch-One']); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Seen-Batch-Two']); String finishName = 'Finished-' + jobId; System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = :finishName]); } }
